method.startup_interval: Before MCP process launch through the first completed assignment, including MCP initialization and tool discovery.
method.warm_interval: One complete public send call after the first assignment.
method.dependency_preparation: None: existing Python executable and published R library selected; ir/uv absent from child PATH; R resolution disabled.
method.execution: Variants ending in -sandbox use the default read-only sandbox; other variants use direct execution. Normal Console recording in a new temporary workspace per launch.
method.cache_state: Installed-runtime caches remain warm. Jupyter launches use fresh IPython profiles; direct launches use fresh Jupyter configuration directories, and sandboxed launches use disposable worker caches.
method.memory: ps RSS after warm cells for Console and all descendants; includes shared-page double counting, excludes benchmark client, is not peak RSS.
method.sample_order: Round robin in listed variant order, one new launch per variant per round.
method.shared_initialization: builtin-r-python and ark-shared-ipykernel-python variants execute invisible(NULL) in R before the first Python assignment, within the startup interval.

source_provenance.verified_overlay: All 186 production files under src/ match the source_revision commit byte-for-byte; native checkout is a disposable copy with that source overlay.
